statements.status_notes: JLine 3.9.0 classes are shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime pulled by Druid's Hadoop-based extensions. Druid does not start an interactive JLine shell or load org.jline reader builtins in the broker/historical/middleManager runtime; the shaded copies are not on an attacker-reachable execute path. Dependency management pins org.jline modules to 3.30.15 for non-shaded copies.
